claim: The paper-auto router depends on Alpaca Paper broker semantics, Alpaca market-data feed limits, NASDAQ opening execution structure, and leveraged ETF risk controls; these external assumptions must remain sourced before router order authorization.
impact_on_spec: Keep broker orders disabled unless execution policy, source cards, paper safety review, and router order authorization are all present.
limitations: Meta card pointing to the specific official-source cards in this file; not independent market evidence.

claim: Alpaca Paper order handling and supported order fields must be verified before any Alpaca Paper broker order is submitted from the router.
impact_on_spec: Execution policy must use broker-supported order styles and time-in-force values; router authorization remains Alpaca Paper only.
limitations: Broker docs and supported fields can change; re-check before live-money design. Paper fills are not live execution evidence.

claim: Alpaca Paper is a simulated trading environment, so authorization in this repository must remain scoped to paper orders and must not imply real-money execution approval.
impact_on_spec: Router order authorization artifact must state order_scope=alpaca_paper_only and real_money_broker_writes=out_of_scope.
limitations: Paper account behavior can differ from live fills, liquidity, and queue priority.

claim: Alpaca market-data feed choice matters; IEX evidence is not equivalent to consolidated SIP/full-market evidence unless account entitlements prove SIP access.
impact_on_spec: Readiness and runbooks must retain IEX caveats and keep cross-source validation as a separate live-readiness gate.
limitations: Feed availability depends on account/subscription; this card does not certify SIP access.

claim: NASDAQ opening price formation is an opening-cross process, so next-open execution requires explicit gap, open-price, partial-fill, and TCA review rather than assuming frictionless fills.
impact_on_spec: Execution policy must compare opening-auction and delayed-open alternatives and record official-open TCA evidence.
limitations: Exchange market-structure documentation does not guarantee Alpaca Paper fills match live opening-auction behavior.

claim: Leveraged and inverse ETFs reset daily and can diverge from long-horizon multiples because of compounding, volatility, and path dependence.
impact_on_spec: TQQQ, SQQQ, SOXL, and other leveraged sleeves require gap stress, leveraged ETF risk notes, and ongoing TCA review before paper orders.
limitations: Regulatory risk disclosure is not alpha evidence.

claim: TQQQ is designed around a daily leveraged objective, reinforcing that multi-day router exposure has path-dependency and rebalance-decay risk.
impact_on_spec: Keep leveraged ETF mitigation and monitoring mandatory for TQQQ-heavy route states.
limitations: Issuer product disclosure is not strategy-performance evidence.
